ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

2. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

4. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 32

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 10

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

12. Solve for x: x + 5 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 11
   C. 7
   D. 5

13. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

14. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 40

17. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

18. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

19. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 11

20. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 18

21. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

22. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 1

23. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 16
   C. 55
   D. 32

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
